status: implemented and synthetic tests passed; full corpus and holdout evaluation remain parent-owned

api.constructor: LocalSearchIndex(index_dir): lazy read-only load for search; no files created until build
api.search: search(query, top_k=5, allowed_doc_ids=None, method="rrf", fetch_k=30, mmr_lambda=0.75) -> flat complete chunk dictionaries plus score/rank/method/score_kind/score_is_confidence=False
api.scope: None is global, [] returns no hits, aliases resolve once, unknown document IDs raise ValueError. Filtering occurs before BM25/TF-IDF candidate truncation and hence before RRF/MMR.
api.get_document_chunks: get_document_chunks(doc_id) accepts an alias and returns all canonical chunks in original build sequence
api.get_catalog: get_catalog() returns a deep copy of canonical metadata, aliases, source SHA256, file_name, agency, document_year, optional metadata_context.title
api.get_metadata: get_metadata() returns a deep copy of persisted metadata
api.resolve_doc_ids: resolve_doc_ids(alias_ids) accepts string/list and returns ordered deduplicated canonical IDs; None rejected

methods.bm25: SQLite FTS5 BM25 over separately tokenized body and metadata. Korean full words plus 2/3-character subwords, normalized numbers and declared domain-category tags. Larger score is better.
methods.char_tfidf: Local lexical char_wb TF-IDF cosine similarity using float32; not semantic embeddings.
methods.rrf: Actual weighted reciprocal-rank sum weight/(rrf_k+rank), not concatenation. Component ranks and scores returned.
methods.mmr: Diversity selection from top fetch_k fused candidates using normalized RRF relevance and maximum character-TFIDF cosine redundancy. Returned objective may be negative and is not confidence.

preprocessing.source_text: Never modified; stored full original chunk JSON includes source_spans and warnings.
preprocessing.no_gold_data: Module imports/reads no evaluation files and never builds queries from expected facts.

config_defaults.term_expansions: Full fixed vocabulary declared in module DEFAULT_TERM_EXPANSIONS and persisted into config.

persistence.security: No pickle, model downloads, network clients, API keys or external services.
cache_guards: full ordered chunk JSON content fingerprint (including text/source SHA/spans/metadata)
persistence.cache_behavior: Matching valid build reuses cache. Explicit build rebuilds stale/damaged cache; lazy search fails loudly and requests rebuild. Stage artifacts are prepared before replacement; metadata is replaced last.

coverage: Korean compounds and search-only spaced-Hangul restoration
numbers/VAT qualifiers and fixed term expansion
prefiltered scope for all four methods
true rank fusion and zero component weights
deterministic reload and valid cache reuse
changed text under same chunk ID forces rebuild
artifact/config corruption rejected and explicit build recovers
full source metadata and score labels
validation.integration: Session agent reports its 20 session tests pass, including a real LocalSearchIndex smoke over all four methods.
validation.test_small_corpus: Two-document unique-character-ngram test explicitly uses min_df=1; production baseline min_df=2 remains unchanged.

limitations: No semantic embedding or neural reranking is represented by this local lexical baseline.
Scores are ranking metrics and are not calibrated answer confidence.
TF-IDF min_df=2 prunes terms occurring in only one chunk; documented config is inspectable.
Unmeasured on holdout and no OpenAI API live call performed by this module.
